name: 转转
description: fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
text:
#!name=转转
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = app.zhuanzhuan.com

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/app\.zhuanzhuan\.com\/zzx\/transfer\/getConfigInfo/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/app\.zhuanzhuan\.com\/zzopen\/popwindow\/getallpopwin\?/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/app\.zhuanzhuan\.com\/zz\/v2\/zzlogic\/getOpenScreen/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/app\.zhuanzhuan\.com\/zz\/transfer\/userred\?scene=homePage/i then reject_dict(200)
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/app\.zhuanzhuan\.com\/zz\/v2\/zzinfoshow\/getfeedflowinfo\?/i then response.body.replace(/userRed/, "fmz200")
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/app\.zhuanzhuan\.com\/zz\/v2\/zzinfoshow\/getchoicegoodsinfos/i then response.body.replace(/infoData/, "fmz200")

[Script]
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/app\.zhuanzhuan\.com\/zz\/transfer\/getmyprofilev3/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/zhuanzhuan/zhuanzhuan.js") with enable=${vrvr_enable}, tag="转转", timeout=60, requires_body=true
